title: check_change_approval output
description: The response envelope. On success, data is the answer: the gate level, whether the change is approved, what is missing, the fail mode and whether the emergency path applies. The answer is advice to the pipeline. Release Later.
$comment: Release Later, after the gate decision (D-03). The pipeline acts on the answer at Advise or Enforce. The product never stops anything itself.

answer.description: The gate answer (later contract list). The pipeline decides what to do with it.

approved.description: True when the change has the approvals its policy requires.

requirement.description: What is missing, such as change authorization.

why.description: One plain sentence from the engine.

missing.description: What is missing. Empty when approved.

emergencyPath.description: True when the emergency rule applies: the deployment may go first, and the authorization follows within the emergency follow-up time.

message.description: One or two plain sentences for the pipeline log.

gateCheckId.description: The Gate Check row that logs the question and the answer.

examples.summary: The change is not authorized yet. At Advise the pipeline warns and goes on.

missing.why: The business owner has not approved the change yet.

data.message: Change not authorized. Advise: continue and flag.
